reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation exact-preparation, substrate, clinical-phenotype, element/species, birth-phenotype, or strain/product evidence gate. They receive no marked prompt, generation call, or raster.
promotionRule: No Batch 089 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its preparation, substrate, phenotype, element/species, strain/product, exposure, measurement, outcome, and evidence conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Inanimate-cell preparations, cell-free supernatants, purified metabolites, lysates, and class-wide benefits and safety are conflated contrary to the consensus boundary.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define exact source strain, inactivation method, retained cells/components, metabolites, composition, dose, target host, comparator, endpoint, safety, and evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: Chemically diverse substrates, foods, taxa, cross-feeding, branded products, disease claims, and synbiotic evidence are generalized as one prebiotic effect.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by defined substrate, matrix/dose, target host and site, utilizing organism/pathway, assay, comparator, health endpoint, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: PMS and PMDD, smoking and metal exposures, hormones, microbiome associations, speculative mechanisms, and interventions are merged with causal wording.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Rebuild around prospective criteria, separate PMS from PMDD, and define population, cycle phase, specimen, assay, exposure/intervention, comparator, endpoint, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Distinct elements/species, exposure matrices, placental transfer, fetal dose, gestational windows, epigenetic and microbiome associations, and outcomes are conflated.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by exact element/species, source, maternal/placental/cord matrix, timing, transfer metric, dose/units, endpoint, cohort/model, assay, confounders, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: Spontaneous and indicated preterm birth, vaginal associations, infection pathways, neonatal sequelae, post-delivery exposures, and prevention are collapsed into one chain.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by phenotype and gestational subgroup; define population, sampling time/site, community method, exposure/intervention, comparator, outcome, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Strain-, product-, dose-, population-, and endpoint-specific results are generalized across a class and mixed across models, trials, reviews, and engineered organisms.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Create exact strain/product records with taxonomy, strain ID, viable dose, formulation, route, population/model, comparator, endpoint, safety, and evidence tier.
